description: The template under a name written with a Unicode escape, `t\u0065mplate:`, its text kept in a constant. The parser holds the name's text, `template`, and so does ngc, which compiles the template (measured through ngc in partial mode and the linker for `check-parts`). The pattern read the name as written and saw no template, and the text `New` passed every point; a read of the name as written (`getText()`) would pass it again.
